verdict.rationale: Ramp documents a shipping in-product AI layer, "Ramp Intelligence", that works on the customer's own data. It fills in memos and categories, auto-codes transactions from history and team feedback, scans transactions in real time for anomalies, and flags risky items for review. That clearly delivers AI-generated suggestions inside the product. The spend-trend and forecasting insights are documented only through Ramp MCP in external assistants such as ChatGPT and Claude, not as an in-app analytics feature. Missing for 10: documented in-product insight surfaces (spend trends, forecasts, recommendations) beyond coding and flagging suggestions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI suggestions' quality.
